balls.text: tapped to the off side for a single, which means there's just four from the final over
moves well across the stumps, looking to sweep, he misses, the balls down the leg side, umpire doesn't signal a wide, correctly
a swipe towards midwicket, Tiwary scrambles back for the second
worked towards cover for another single, great start to the over from Patel
skips down the track, defended by shamoi
short of length ball, defended towards cover for a single
send away towards deep midwicket for a single
full and outside off, batsman has backed away from the stumps, and can't get near the ball

Maxwell! can this man do anything wrong this season? sensational catch from him, Parnell did hammer this one as Hendricks gifted a length ball, the ball goes high and drops sharply down, Maxwell skips back towards the rope, and he's less than a yard from the boundary when he gets his hands on the ball, he doesn't collect it on the first time, but as the ball drops he sticks out his left hand to pluck that one, a wide grin shows how much he enjoyed that
length ball on the pads, a clip over midwicket for two, touch-play from Parnell there, not looking to hammer the ball
low full toss on middle stump, driven towards long-on for a single

wickets tumbling here, a short slow ball there from Hendricks, bowled from the back of the hand, sits up for Karthik, who looks to hook that away for six, but doesn't get enough on it and holes out to deep square leg
full toss on middle stump, pretty high, Manoj Tiwary opens the face and sends that in front of point for four
full ball on legstump from around the wicket, Sandeep has decided that is going to be his strategy, and it is working for him, Mayank goes for the reverse-sweep, he misses and loses his leg stump
wow! what a shot first ball from Mayank, Sandeep delivers a length ball from over the wicket, a crisp, clean hit over cover for four, top shot

targetting the legstump with yorkers here, Karthik gets on one knee as he looks to thrash it through the leg side, he misses and is struck on the flap of the back pad, struck outside leg so the lbw appeal is turned down
superb ball form Sandeep, a yorker from round the wicket, Karthik jams his bat down in time
the promotion for Jadhav doesn't work as he perishes first ball, it was a length ball to hit out of the park, but Jadhav hits it only as far as deep midwicket where Maxwell is waiting
another full toss, slams this wide of wide long-on this time, Karthik showing Duminy how the previous ball should have been dealt with, gets a boundary

this time the yorker has gone completely awry, it is a nice put-it-away full toss, but in T20 even this sort of delivery can get you a wicket, Duminy wanted to put it away but he doesn't hit it well enough clear Maxwell at wide long-on
goes for the yorker again, Hendricks misses the length just a touch, a low full toss on the pads, slapped away towards deep square
full ball on the pads, worked behind square leg for a single
full ball from round the wicket, guided down towards deep backward square leg, Karthik scrambles back for the second

Hendricks returns with a superb yorker that follows Duminy, who somehow manages to get a bit of bat on it and turns over the strike, the third-umpire is needed to see whether Karthik has made his ground, he has
tucked to the leg side for a single, and that will be the strategic time-out
wants to bludgeon this one, can one send it dribbling towards midwicket
a full toss, Karthik skips down the track and launches this straight over the bowler's head, middles it and that's six towards the sightscreen

there's the slog sweep from Karthik, it's a shot he plays very well, gets on one knee and connects with the length ball, he can't send it all the way, but he can put it in the gap and that bounces away to the square-leg boundary
whips this one in front of square leg for a single
whoah, how low did that stay? a short of length ball just above creeps above ankle height, Dumin gets his bat down in time
full and on the pads, clipped in front of square leg for a single
fuller and on off stump, driven towards long-on for a single
Dhawan drops short, Karthik capitalises, hammers this one to the midwicket boundary

drives this on the up, doesn't seem to have put in too much power on this, the back swing stops before the end of the blade reaching shoulder height, but that comes right off the middle of the bat and amazingly the ball soars over long-off for six
shortish ball that sits up, Duminy doesn't try to hammer that out of the park, instead deftly guides it towards fine leg for four, Dhawan not thrilled with the length there
full ball on the pads, Duminy moves across and whips it to midwicket for a single, played with a flourish that shot
crisply driven off the front foot, but not past short cover
shortish ball outside off, Karthik wants to power that down the ground, again doesn't middle it and the ball rolls towards long-off
slanting in towards the pads, defended towards the leg side for a single
tossed up, full ball, Karthik wants to swat it away, but mistimes it towards midwicket
length ball is punched off the back foot to long-off for one more
Duminy gets forward and tapped it to long-off for one more, a tidy over from Dhawan despite the boundary
eased towards long-off for a single

this time he tries a cute reverse-dab, wanting to get the ball fine past the keeper who is standing up, he doesn't connect, and a disappointed Karthik walks away from the stumps to take a moment to clear his head
not as good a shot this, it was back of a length and outside off, Karthik goes for the slog to midwicket but misses out
short of length ball just outside off, Karthik sways away to make room and thumps that past point, superbly struck
pushed towards long-off for a single by Duminy
worked off his pads to deep square leg.
tries to give himself room and cut. Cramped for room, hits it to point.
short, doesn't turn, DK pulls it to long-on. He might have been looking to hit more towards midwicket.
tossed up, checked drive to long-off.
slogged down to wide long-on
walks across, gets down on one knee, and finally beats short fine leg with the sweep, Sandeep almost cuts it off with a dive on the boundary, but can't quite complete the task.
driven down to mid-off.
tucks this leg-stump ball off his hips to short fine leg
back in his crease, defends watchfully.

what a ball! All those balls that went straight on were maybe playing on KP's mind, and he pushed forward here and was playing for the angle rather than for the turn. Unfortunately for him, it does turn, and turns appreciably to beat his outside edge and crash into middle and off.
looking for the cut, but it goes on with the arm, and he pushes defensively at it.
keeps a bit low, KP is vigilant, jams down on it.
down the track, gets too close to the pitch, pushes it back to the bowler.
turns in from off, tucked away towards midwicket, Maxi runs in from the boundary and sends in a flat throw to the keeper, but the batsmen completed two comfortably.
worked wristily from outside off to long-on.
short, and KP chops it down to deep point.
slog-sweep to deep square leg.
tossed up, outside off, doesn't turn, pushed back to the bowler.
tries to flick, gets an inside-edge onto the pad, bounces off towards point.
inventive from KP, almost beats short third man, but Sehwag dives full-length to his left to cut off this cute little dab, from middle stump.
angled in, back of a length, tucks DK up, pushes it down to long-on
looks to beat short fine leg this time with a hard-hit sweep, but once again, straight to the fielder
walks across the stumps, tries to work this from outside off past midwicket, hits it to the fielder.
short, wide, cut, four. Anything short is sitting up on this pitch. There was some bounce, but DK got on top of it really well.
gets bat on it this time, good-looking flick to deep midwicket.
down the track, looks to work it into the leg side, is hit on the pad again.
stays next to the line of a straight ball and drives it towards deep cover
flicked towards mid-on
tries to sweep, is hit on the pad again
goes with the angle, dowm the leg side, and it hits DK's pad as he misses the flick

driven this time, and it's timed really well. The sweeper on the off side boundary didn't have too far to run to his right, but the ball streaks past him as he threw himself at it. He got a hand to it, though.
width this time, and that's as good a square cut as you'll see, goes flying away behind point.
another typical Rishi Dhawan delivery, angled in towards off, and KP stays leg-side of it and drives it to deep cover.
slower ball, driven down to a straightish mid-off.
angled in again, good length, and DK pushes it into the off side.
angled in towards off. DK presses forward to defend.
another one goes with the arm. KP was looking to drive through the covers, gets an inside edge that trickles towards fine leg.
skids on, KP misses the flick, and it thuds into his pad, but well wide of leg stump.
worked to wide mid-on off the pads.
looks for the cut, ball tucks him up, and he manages to chop it down in front of point.
loopy ball on leg stump, tucked towards midwicket.
short, wide, cut away in front of point.
leg-stumpish ball, DK misses the sweep. Slightly harsh wide call, you'd think.
pushes forward outside off with an open face, steers it backward of deep point.
down on one knee. It was swinging away from middle stump, but he's still middled that sweep, or was it a pull from a sweep-ish position, over deep square leg.
thrusts forward to an outswinger outside off, defensive push to the left of cover.
short, wide, but point had been pushed back in Sandy's previous over, and he's there to stop this slash from KP.
angles in towards KP's pads. Wristy flick, stopped by midwicket diving to his left.
bit of inswing. DK comes forward to defend, gets a thick inside edge into the leg side.
uh oh. Another one slides down the leg side.

short again, but the bowler got much more shoulder into this one, and it rises up towards KP's right shoulder. He wasn't fully in control of that hook, but it flew over the deep backward square leg boundary.
short, sits up again, but KP doesn't quite get hold of the pull. Falls well short of the deep midwicket boundary.
width again, and KP throws his bat at it. Thick edge goes flying away to the left of third man.
similar length to the previous ball, but closer to off stump. Pushed to mid-off
bit of width again, sits up, and KP stays leg side of the ball to flay it between point and cover
worked off his hips behind square leg.
straightens from a good length on off stump, driven to the off-side sweeper.
closer to off stump this time, and KP steers it to short third man, who had come up for this ball as point went back.
width, and KP slashes it powerfully, from halfway forward, to the deep point boundary.
down the leg side again, and KP hurriedly sticks his back foot into the crease when he realises Saha is standing up. Lovely take down the leg side, lightning hands.

taken! short, Vijay half-pulls, half-flicks, and the top-edge goes way up in the air. Swirls all the way as it comes down, and Beuran Hendricks is running back from the 30-yard circle towards the deep square leg boundary, and is facing away from the field as he takes it, inches from the rope. Top catch.
back of a length, just outside off, Vijay drives to extra cover
swing, but it's wasted, goes way down the leg side
stays in his crease, opens his bat-face to steer it behind point.
good line, giving the batsman no room. Vijay tries to force it past point, finds the fielder.
slower ball, angled from middle towards off, goes off the inside edge towards midwicket.
back of a length, on off, pushed off the back foot into the off side.
cramped for room, hit towards square leg.
short, and pulled witheringly in front of midwicket.
full and wide, slapped to cover.
another full ball, Vijay pushes it to mid-off.
gorgeous. outswinger, full and wide, and Vijay leans into it to send it hurrying past cover.
jams this off the inside part of his bat towards backward square leg
swishes at a wide, full ball, misses. Suspect it was the slower one.
straightens this time, from just outside off, and KP defends solidly. He's taking guard outside the crease.
bit of inswing. Lots of inswing, in fact, and Vijay gets an inside edge that skitters away towards fine leg.

it's all over, Kings XI win another, making absolutely certain of their place in the playoffs, Delhi sink to their seventh straight loss, the result was confirmed with a powerful pull towards deep midwicket for four, it was tight, but once again Kings XI pull through

great running from Aksar Patel there, that full toss was drilled past the bowler, didn't look like there would be time for two, but Patel was nearly lapping Dhawan there, so quick was he off the blocks
short ball, Dhawan doesn't know much about that one, a top edge towards square leg, Tahir has plenty of ground to cover, so the batsmen can hare back for the second, in time to beat the throw
full and outside off, sliced towards deep point for a single
big googly from Tahir, nearly got through after Dhawan skips down the track, off the pads
dot ball, Dhawan can't get it away, down the track
pushed towards cover for a tight single, almost an overthrow there, direct hit would have been close there

taken! this game is back alive, Bailey perishes, a needless big hit, don't think he picked the googly, and that flies off the inside half of the bat towards deep midwicket, where Jadhav takes a good diving catch, two rookies will have to finish the job now
googly from Tahir, Bailey drives it in front of point
steps down and drives towards long-off for a single
driven towards long-on for a single to end the over
and that's surely the game, a full toss outside off is thumped over long-off for six, Patel a strong contender for Man of the Match here

a yorker into the toes, Patel jams it back towards the bowler, again the third umpire is called for after a half-hearted appeal from Unadkat, this time Patel played it into the ground, then onto the boot and to the bowler
short of length and outside off, guided down to third man for a single, calm and risk-free from Bailey
mistimes a hack down the ground, past the bowler for a single
short of length ball outside off, steered down to third man for a single
guided to backward point to complete a quick single
short once more, Bailey sends it towards deep point for a couple
Tahir drags it short, Patel slaps it towards deep square leg for a single
bottom edges the ball towards first slip this time, pretty cool that they have a first slip in place at this stage of the innings
spinning away from the left-hander who defends towards point
Bailey eases the first ball towards long-on for a single
on the pads, helped along to the fine leg boundary, poor deliveries to start and end the over, that means three fours in the over, and Kings XI remain in control
shortish ball outside off, Patel swishes and misses
defended towards short midwicket

that was a superb comeback from Parnell, a toe-crusher of a yorker, that seemed a good shout for lbw, it is off the boot and past the keeper for four, umpire Dharmasena gives it as four runs, though that crashed straight into the boot, might have missed leg, but could have been given out as well
Parnell starts with a shortish ball outside off, carved behind backward point for four

full ball outside off, driven to short cover, was that a bump ball? the third umpire is called for after much delay, there wasn't too much of an appeal from the fielder Parnell initially, but the replays show the batsman is out, hit the ball just after it bounced and chipped it straight to Parnell, another wicket for Daredevils
full and wide, much too wide
down the leg side, helped along to short fine
on legstump, tapped towards short midwicket
defended back towards the bowler
short ball and Shami continues to leak runs, thumped behind point for four, reaches the rope after one bounce
short of length ball angling across, past the outside edge to the keeper
length ball outside off, defended back to the bowler
wide down the leg side
dances down the track and defends to the off side
Saha again going for the reverse-dab, bottom edges it and the ball bounces through to the keeper
length ball on off, eased to long-on for one more
pushed towards long-on for a single
way outside off, Saha skips down the track and stretches forward as he reaches for the ball, connects well enough to get a boundary behind point

a low full toss and that is clubbed towards long-on, another misfield concedes an extra run, Vijay the culprit this time, Unadkat had four overthrows earlier in the game as well, besides these misfields
length ball is eased towards sweeper cover for one more
slower ball, just back of a length, defended to the off side, Saha thinks about the single and then decides against it
on the pads, helped down to fine leg for a single
short of length ball is slapped towards backward point, where there is a diving stop
from round the wicket, pushed towards cover, where it should have been a single at most, but Shami put in an amateur effort and lets the ball through, conceding two extra runs
length ball ,Saha skips down the track, sends the ball towards deep midwicket for a single
driven along the ground towards long-off for a single
Saha goes for the reverse-dab, sends the ball towards short third for a single
length ball outside off, thumped towards wide long-on
length ball is wristily worked towards long-on for a single
towards the pads, looks to whip it away but doesn't connect

there's an appeal for a stumping after the ball slips down the leg side, third umpire is called for, Patel was looking to glance that one but he missed, his back leg was out of the ground for a moment, but he quickly drags it back, seemed straightforward but the third umpire takes many, many replays before deciding
hacked towards long-off for a single, bringing up the 100
short of length ball just outside off, defended down the track
slants in towards off, batsman opens the face and misses
short and wide outside off, poor ball and gets the treatment, Patel reaches out and hits that towards deep extra cover
defended towards short midwicket this time
gets some extra bounce there, this was just outside off, Patel is beaten
sliding on towards off, inside-edges it towards backward square leg

the game is changing here, dramatically, Punjab have lost Miller now, he was looking to send that down the ground, he doesn't connect, the ball connects with leg stump, Punjab have lost four in three and a half overs
defended back towards the bowler, Duminy getting through a quiet over here
pushed to long-on for a single
worked away to long-off for a single
inside-edges this one onto his pads
Tahir has got the big one, the googly has crashed into the off stump, Maxwell misses the swipe, Maxwell has to go, Tahir has already gone off on his usual over exuberant celebratory run

nearly a catch in the deep, Maxwell can't connect as well as he wants, but he will be lucky he didn't connect just a little bit more as the ball lands just short a diving Manoj Tiwary, who is struck on his shoulder and manages to slow the ball enough to stop it reaching the rope, Tahir applauds the effort
spinning in towards the pads, eased towards long-on for a single
quicker one outside off, Miller looks to work the ball through off but is beaten
Maxwell was charging down and looking to go big, his bat doesn't get near the ball, luckily for him it hits his pads and goes wide of the keeper
full and way down the leg side, well kept by Karthik
skids straight on after pitching on off stump, chopped towards deep point for two
Maxwell works the final ball of the over to short fine leg for a single
Sehwag goes for it again, again Duminy bowls it full and wide, Sehwag can't get enough power on this one, which means he find the man at sweeper cover
Sehwag shows he can hit them big as well, length ball well outside off, clubbed over cover for six
short ball outside off, Maxwell looks for the big hit, bottom-edges it towards mid-off
length ball on the pads, pushed towards long-on for a single
Duminy starts with a shortish ball on the pads, tucked towards deep square leg
driven towards deep extra cover for a single
and it begins, Maxwell effortlessly swipes that a long long way, to cow corner for a big six, the crowd is delirious
defended back towards the bowler this time
huge lbw appeal after Maxwell misses out on the sweep, pitched outside leg, hit him outside leg
that kept low, it was a googly as well, luckily for Maxwell that wasn't in line with the stumps, down the leg side

and Tahir has a wicket straightaway, flighted overpitched ball, Vohra looks to launch that out of the park, it's a good-looking shot but he picked out the man at long-off, end of another hugely impressive cameo from the 20-year-old
starts with a length ball that is pushed towards long-off
Shami sees Sehwag backing away and follows his, Sehwag pushes the ball towards the off side and takes off, a direct hit would have given a few anxious moments for Vohra, but there isn't one
slow full ball, pushed towards mid-off
shortish ball over the stumps, Sehwag arches back as he looks to carve that over point, he misses
misfield at mid-on as Vohra thumps the ball down the ground, just a single
Shami drops it short, Vohra pulls this authoritatively over midwicket for a one-bounce four, Preity Zinta likes that, she's up from the chair and waving the team flag
short of length ball outside off, Vohra waits for the ball to arrive and steers it past short third man, who had just come in from the deep, clever work there
a bouncer that is too high, another wide, Daredevils struggling here
another wide, down the leg side, Daredevils giving away freebies here

angling in towards the pads, Vohra clips it to short fine, Sehwag looked to be short of his ground when the throw came in from Jadhav, Sehwag wasn't stretching, Jadhav mised and the backing up is poor, there are four overthrows in addition to the single
length ball on off stump, driven towards cover
pushed behind point for a single this time
stays low outside off, Sehwag can't get bat on it

dropped, that was a tough chance for Tahir at mid-off, he had run back to get under the ball, and had to take the catch as the ball dropped over his shoulder, he was well placed to take it, but couldn't finish the job, it was a checked drive from Sehwag which sends the ball soaring to mid-off
this one is down the ground, a length ball is launched over the bowler's head for six

an incredible shot from Vohra, astonishing hit from him, Sehwag walks across and pats his back, this was an offcutter coming in, Vohra was on the back foot but he coolly carves it over cover for six, right off the middle of the bat, hardly any follow through but the ball goes a long way, great to watch
Vohra looks to guide the ball down to third man but it slips past the outside off
slanted in towards his pads, cramps Sehwag, off the top of his pads towards backward point
short of length once more, driven towards mid-on
short of length and just outside off, opens the face to guide the ball towards point
length ball on middle and off, defended back towards the bowler
Vohra getting boundaries all over the park now, this time he wasn't intentional, he was looking to thrash a shortish ball to midwicket, a thick bottom edge and down to fine leg for four
a hit-me ball from Parnell, on a length around off stump, thumped over mid-off for four, or is that six? it is six, a yard over the rope
lovely drive from Vohra, beats a diving Pietersen at cover for four
short of length ball, tucked towards midwicket, that hit high on the bat, Parnell gets across to field, Vohra sets off for a quick single, Sehwag doesn't like quick singles, Vohra has to turn back
superb delivery from Parnell, a middle-stump yorker, squeezed out by Vohra
chases a ball that is wide outside off, this time a wide on the other side of the wicket
starts with one well down the leg side, Parnell hitting good pace here, 144kph
blocks the ball, drops a couple of yards away from him but the batsmen still pinch a single
struck on the body this time as Shami angles the ball in

good delivery from Shami, better response from Sehwag, it was back of a length and moving away, Sehwag had to adjust as he was looking to drive, opens the face at the last moment to guide the ball towards third man for four
bottom edges as he looks to pull that one, the ball dribbles towards midwicket
down the leg side, 142kph
this is much better, seams in towards the pads, and just the leg bye this time
starts with a short of length ball, moving away after starting well outside off, Sehwag - as ever - doesn't need to move his feet as he puts that away, a lofted chop over cover for four
a bouncer to end the over, a good one too, 143kph, Vohra ducks under that one
short of length, 143kph, slapped towards cover but not wide of the fielder
behind square leg for one more
once more it is aimed at Sehwag's thigh pad, Sehwag tucks it past short fine, but it isn't fine enough to beat deep backward square
on leg stump, Vohra goes deep in the crease and tucks the ball towards square leg
that was too far outside off for Vohra
starts wit ha back of length 143kph ball on the pads, tipped down to fine leg by Sehwag
